original: 今回の仕事は護衛よ
traducao: Your assignment this time is an escort.

original: モラード村のジョアンさんを\nブラウニー坑道の奥へ\n連れて行ってもらいたいの
traducao: I'd like you to escort Joan\nof Morado Village\ndeep into Brownie Mine.

original: 詳しい話は、\n現地でジョアンさんに聞いてね
traducao: As for the details, you can\nask Joan once you're there.

original: この仕事の同行者は、ファラとマルタ
traducao: Farah and Marta will be going with you.

original: それじゃあ、ジョアンさんに\n怪我をさせてはダメよ？
traducao: Now then, make sure you keep Joan\nsafe from harm, alright?

original: 行ってらっしゃい！
traducao: Have a safe trip!

original: ジョアンさん、大丈夫ですか？\n歩くのも辛そうなのに、\nそんな無理をしてまで行くなんて
traducao: Are you alright, Joan? You look\nlike it hurts just to walk... Why push\nyourself so hard to make this trip?

original: はぁ…、はぁ…、これが…\n私にとっての…最後のチャンスなんだ。\n生き延びる為の…
traducao: *pant*... *pant*... This is...\nmy last chance to survive...\nMy only hope to go on living...

original: 生き延びる為のって…
traducao: To survive...?

original: 私は、もう…長くないんだ。\n医者も見離した病気でね…
traducao: I don't have much time left...\nEven doctors gave up on my illness.

original: ゴホッ、ゴホッ…
traducao: *cough* *cough*...

original: だけど、この奥にいるという\n病気を治してくれる存在に会えれば…
traducao: But if I can meet the being in the depths\nsaid to cure all disease...

original: 病気を治してくれる存在なんて、\n本当にいるのかなあ
traducao: A being that can heal illnesses...\nCould something like that really exist?

original: それは行ってみないとわからないよ
traducao: We won't know until we go and look.

original: ジョアンさん、そこまでしっかり護衛するから\n頑張りましょう！
traducao: We'll escort you safely all the way,\nJoan, so let's do our best!

original: うん、イケる、イケる！
traducao: Yeah, we can do this, we can do it!

original: はい、お願いします…
traducao: Yes... Please help me...

original: ジョアンさん。\nこの先、行き止まりになってますよ…
traducao: Joan...\nIt's a dead end up ahead...

original: はぁ…、はぁ…。\nこっちで、構わない…
traducao: *pant*... *pant*...\nThis way is fine...

original: ごふっ…、ここの鍵を…\n持っているんでね…
traducao: *wheeze*... I have the key...\nto this place...

original: ゴホゴホッ…。\n目的地は…、もうすぐだ
traducao: *cough* *hack*...\nOur destination... is just ahead...

original: あの、ジョアンさん。\nその病気を治す存在って、\nどうやって知ったんですか？
traducao: Um, Joan?\nHow did you find out about this being\nthat can cure illnesses?

original: ゴフッ…、故郷のモラード村に、私と同じ\n病気に…ゴホッ…なったミゲルという男が\nいてね…
traducao: *wheeze*... In my home of Morado Village,\na man named Miguel caught the same...\n*cough*... illness as me...

original: 彼はいい医者に見てもらおうと、\nこの坑道を通って…ゴホゴホッ。\n…大きな街を目指していたんだ
traducao: Hoping to be seen by a good doctor,\nhe passed through this mine... *cough*...\nheading for a larger city...

original: けれども、道中で発作が始まり、\nどうにも身動きが取れなくなって、
traducao: Yet along the way, an attack struck him,\nand he couldn't move at all...

original: 死を覚悟…ゴホゴホッ…したらしい
traducao: He braced... *cough* *hack*... for death.

original: そして、ここで死ぬのかと目をつぶり、\nもっと生きたいと思っていたら
traducao: He closed his eyes, thinking he'd die,\nwishing he could just live longer...

original: ゴホッ、ゴホッ…、\nどこからともなく…、赤い煙が現れたそうだ
traducao: *cough* *cough*...\nOut of nowhere... red smoke appeared.

original: 赤い煙…？
traducao: Red smoke...?

original: 赤い煙は周囲を包み、ミゲルにはそれが\nあの世からの迎えだと思ったそうだ
traducao: The red smoke enveloped him, and Miguel\nthought death had come to take him.

original: それから彼は\n「死にたくない、もっと生きたい」。\nゴホッ…そう、強く願った
traducao: Then, he thought...\n'I don't want to die! I want to live!'\n*cough*... He prayed so fervently...

original: すると、次に気が付いた時は赤い煙はなく、\nすっかり病気は治っていたらしい…
traducao: When he came to, the red smoke was gone,\nand his illness was completely cured...

original: それが病気を治す存在なんだね
traducao: So that's the being that heals people.

original: 実際に体験した人がいたんだ。\n不思議な話…
traducao: Someone actually experienced that, huh?\nWhat a mysterious tale...

original: 何だろう、精霊みたいなものかな？
traducao: I wonder what it is. Like a spirit?

original: 私にもわからないよ
traducao: I don't know either.

original: けれども、私ももっと長生きがしたい。\nその存在に会いたいんだ
traducao: Even so, I want to live longer, too.\nI want to meet this being.

original: 本当に、わらにもすがる思いなんだよ…
traducao: I'm truly grasping at straws here...

original: ゴホッ、ゴホゴホッ…
traducao: *cough*, *hack* *hack*...

original: 目的地はここみたいだけど、\n魔物がいるよ
traducao: Looks like this is the place,\nbut there are monsters here!

original: ちょっと大変そうな相手だけど、\n戦うしかないね！
traducao: They look pretty tough, but\nwe have no choice but to fight!

original: はぁ…、はぁ…。\nお、お願いします！\nアドリビトムの皆さん…
traducao: *pant*... *pant*...\nP-Please protect me,\nmembers of Ad Libitum...!

original: 行こう、○○！
traducao: Let's go, ○○!

original: 今度こそ、負けないんだから！
traducao: This time, I'm definitely not losing!

original: よっし！\n行くよ、○○！
traducao: Alright!\nLet's do this, ○○!

original: ジョアンさん、もうここは安全ですよ
traducao: Joan, it's safe now.

original: はぁ…、はぁ…、ありがとうございます
traducao: *pant*... *pant*... Thank you so much.

original: やはり、一人で来るのは無理だった\nみたいですね…良かった…。\nゴホゴホッ！
traducao: I never could have made it here alone...\nI'm so glad you're here...\n*hack* *cough*!

original: でも、病気を治す存在なんて、\nどこにいるの？
traducao: Still, where is this being\nthat heals illnesses?

original: ミゲルの病気を治してくれた方、\nどこにいるんですか？\n私もお願いに参りました
traducao: You who cured Miguel's illness,\nwhere are you?\nI have come to beg your aid as well!

original: ゴホッ…ゴホッ。\nどうか…、私の病気を…、\n治して下さい！！
traducao: *cough*... *cough*...\nPlease... I beg you...\nHeal my illness!!

original: 息が…、苦しくない…？\n治ったんだ、私の病気が！！\n奇跡だ！
traducao: My breathing... isn't painful...?\nI'm cured! My illness is gone!!\nIt's a miracle!

original: あんなに私を苦しめていたセキも。\n身体の節々の痛みも無い
traducao: That dreadful cough that tormented me...\nThe ache in every joint... All gone!

original: 本当に治ったんだ！！
traducao: I'm truly cured!!

original: ねえ、○○。\n気にならなかった？\nコクヨウ玉虫を包んだ赤い煙の事…
traducao: Say, ○○.\nDid you notice that red smoke\nthat enveloped the Obsidian Jewel Beetle?

original: わたし…、\n今のを見て、思い出したんだ
traducao: Seeing that...\nit just reminded me of something.

original: あの、ジョアンさん。\n本当に大丈夫なんですか？
traducao: Um, Joan?\nAre you really sure you're alright?

original: いやぁ？　大丈夫だよ
traducao: Hm? Of course I am!

original: ああ、とてもすがすがしい気分だ。\n健康とは、こんなにも素晴らしいもの\nだったのか！
traducao: Ah, I feel so refreshed!\nTo think good health was such\na wonderful thing!

original: さあ、ここを出よう。\n早く帰って、みんなの為に\nバリバリ働くぞ！
traducao: Come, let's head out of here.\nI'll rush back and work my hardest\nfor everyone!

original: 大丈夫かなぁ…
traducao: I wonder if he's really okay...

original: うん。\n何か、こっちが\nすっきりしない気分だね…
traducao: Yeah...\nI can't help feeling\na little uneasy about this...

original: 結果的に病気は治ってたみたいだけど。\nジョアンさん、本当に大丈夫かな
traducao: His illness seemed to be cured, but...\nis Joan really going to be alright?

original: 赤い煙が、生物変化の原因…かも\nしれないんでしょ？
traducao: The red smoke could be what caused\nthe creature mutations... right?

original: まだ、確定ではない。\nキールが街で聞いた話、\nオレ達がオルタータ火山で見た赤い煙…
traducao: Nothing is certain yet.\nWhat Keele heard in town, and the red\nsmoke we saw at Alterata Volcano...

original: はっきりわかっているのは、赤い煙と\n生物変化という現象が「実在した」という\n事までだ
traducao: All we know for certain is that both\nthe red smoke and the creature mutations\nactually happened.

original: この二つの現象の因果関係は、\nまだ確認していないからな
traducao: We have yet to confirm any causal link\nbetween those two phenomena.

original: だが、赤い煙…。\nやはり、単なるガスなどの物質とは\n考えにくい
traducao: Still, that red smoke...\nIt's hard to believe it's merely\nsome ordinary matter like gas.

original: あれは、超常的な何かかもしれない
traducao: It might be something supernatural.

original: 自然界のものにも、科学的に作り出した\nものにも、あんな特性を持った物質は\nないからな
traducao: Nothing in nature or synthetic science\ndisplays properties quite like that,\nafter all.

original: そうね…、わからない事はまだ多いなぁ
traducao: Indeed... There's so much left unknown.

original: 赤い煙が危険なのかどうかすらわからないし、\nもうこれに関する依頼は受けられないかな…
traducao: We don't know if that red smoke is safe,\nso we can't take requests tied to it...

original: 何かあったの？
traducao: Did something happen?

original: 護衛の依頼が殺到しているのよ。\n例の「病気を治す存在」の元へ連れて行って\n欲しいって
traducao: We've been flooded with escort requests.\nPeople want us to take them to this being\nthat supposedly cures illnesses.

original: ずいぶん、噂が広まってるみたい
traducao: The rumors seem to have spread quite far.

original: 仕事が増えるのは嬉しいけれど、\nあんな得体のしれないものに引き合わせて、\n依頼者とトラブルになったら大変でしょ
traducao: I'm glad to have more work, but...\nintroducing clients to an unknown entity\ncould easily cause trouble for us.

original: ああ、むしろ今後は接触させない様に\nしなければならないな
traducao: Right. Moving forward, we should keep\npeople from coming into contact with it.

original: そうね。\nこれから危ない仕事が増えそうだし、\n…もっと人を増やさないと駄目かも
traducao: Indeed.\nDangerous jobs will likely increase now,\nso we may need to bring in more people.

original: アテがあるから、手紙を出してみましょう
traducao: I have an idea, so I'll send a letter.

original: それじゃ、今回はお疲れ様。\nまたお願いね、○○
traducao: Well then, thank you for your hard work.\nI'll be counting on you next time, ○○.

original: よう、来たぜアンジュ
traducao: Yo, Ange! I made it.

original: いらっしゃい、スパーダ君。\n旅先まで手紙が届いて、良かったぁ
traducao: Welcome, Spada!\nI'm so glad my letter reached you!

original: なーんか、ギルド始めたって書いてあって\nビックリしたぜ
traducao: Caught me off guard reading you started\na guild of your own, though!

original: ルカとイリアもいるんだろ？
traducao: Ruca and Iria are here too, right?

original: ええ、二人とも待ってるよ。\nすぐ部屋に案内するね
traducao: Yes, both of them are waiting.\nI'll show you to their room right away.

original: リカルドさんは一緒じゃないの？
traducao: Isn't Ricardo with you?

original: ちょっくら雇われて戦場へ行ったぜ。\n一仕事終わったら、連絡してくるんじゃね？
traducao: Got hired for a battlefield gig.\nHe'll get in touch once the job's done.

original: うおっと、スパーダじゃん。\n何しに来たワケ？
traducao: Whoa, if it isn't Spada!\nWhat brings you here?

original: リカルドと旅してたんじゃないの？
traducao: Weren't you traveling with Ricardo?

original: 何しにって、アンジュが手伝いに\n来いっつったから、来たんだよ
traducao: What d'you mean? Ange told me to come\nlend a hand, so here I am.

original: 旅も出来るし、面白そうだしな
traducao: Plus I get to travel, and it sounded fun.

original: んじゃ、ルカちゃまと\nあたしの部屋まで案内してやるか
traducao: Well then, guess I'll take you\nto little Ruca's and my room.

original: おお、ルカちゃまな。\n久しぶりにイジってやるか。\nグヘヘ…
traducao: Oh, little Ruca, huh?\nTime to mess with him after so long.\nHehehe...

original: 久しぶりだからって、\nあんまりやり過ぎないでよ
traducao: Just 'cause it's been a while,\ndon't take it too far, got it?

original: あー、シメのいじりは譲れってか？
traducao: Ah, savin' the final jab for yourself?

original: よくわかってんじゃん。\nギヒヒヒヒヒ…
traducao: Look who gets it.\nGyahihihihi...

original: ○○、\n彼らにとっては、いつもの事だから\n気にしないで
traducao: ○○,\nthat's just business as usual for them,\nso pay it no mind.

original: 基本、行き過ぎない程度までは\nわたしもスルーしてるし
traducao: As long as it doesn't go overboard,\nI usually let it slide, too.

original: そうそう、あなたにも彼を紹介するから\n部屋へいらっしゃい
traducao: Oh right! I'll introduce him to you,\nso come along to the room.

original: あン、誰だァコイツ？
traducao: Huh? Who's this?

original: ちょっ、スパーダったらもう！\nこのギルドの仲間だよ
traducao: Come on, Spada!\nThey're our guildmate!

original: おー、そうか。\nってか、ビビらすつもりは\nさらさら無かったんだけどな
traducao: Oh, gotcha.\nDidn't mean to scare 'em or nothin',\nfor the record.

original: 君は、誰に対してもそうだけど\n中には恐がる人もいるし…
traducao: You act like that with everyone, but\nsome people really get scared...

original: ルカとかな、ヒャハハハ！\n初めて会った時のお前、そうだったよな
traducao: Like you, right? Hyahaha!\nYou were just like that when we met!

original: オレはスパーダ。\nスパーダ・ベルフォルマ
traducao: I'm Spada.\nSpada Belforma.

original: こいつらのダチだ、よろしくな
traducao: Pal of these guys. Nice to meet ya.

original: ところで、スパーダ君。\n手紙にも書いておいたけど、\n情報は仕入れてきてくれた？
traducao: By the way, Spada.\nLike I wrote in my letter,\ndid you gather any information?

original: あー、赤い煙ってヤツかぁ？\nアレ、割と知れ渡っているみたいだな
traducao: Ah, that red smoke stuff?\nWord of that seems pretty widespread.

original: 気になんのは、見る者によって、\nその煙の姿が違うらしいって事だ
traducao: Thing is, it seems its form varies\ndepending on who looks at it.

original: 姿？\n煙とかモヤとか、\nそんな不定形なものでしょ？
traducao: Form?\nIsn't it shapeless like smoke\nor haze or something?

original: ソイツの存在がわかった頃は\n煙だったらしいな
traducao: Seems it started out as smoke\nwhen folks first discovered it.

original: けど今は、花や、虫、魚、色んな姿で\n現れるらしいぜ
traducao: Now it appears in all sorts of forms:\nflowers, bugs, fish, you name it.

original: …まるで、進化しているみたいだね
traducao: ...It's almost like it's evolving.

original: それだけじゃねェ。\n変わってんのは街の人もだ
traducao: That ain't all.\nFolks in town are changin', too.

original: 「病気を治す」から、いつの間にか\n「願いを叶える」って話になってんだぜ
traducao: Went from 'curing illness' to\n'granting wishes' before anyone noticed.

original: 願いを叶える？
traducao: Granting wishes...?

original: …それはもはや……。\nそれは、病気を治すなんて\nものではない…
traducao: ...That goes far beyond...\nThat's no mere thing\nthat simply cures diseases...

original: もっと、「とんでもない」ものよ
traducao: It's something far more outrageous.

original: 願いを叶える、か…
traducao: Granting wishes, huh...?

original: じゃあ、もっとたくさんの人が\nその存在に会いたがるんだろうね
traducao: Then even more people will probably\nwant to go seek it out...

original: スパーダがアドリビトムに加入しました
traducao: Spada has joined Ad Libitum.

original: ○○、\nもうすっかりここに慣れたみたいね。\n仕事もすごく頑張ってるし
traducao: ○○,\nit looks like you're right at home now.\nYou've been working so hard, too.

original: どうかな。\n何か、思い出せた記憶ってある？
traducao: How are you feeling?\nHave you remembered anything at all?

original: そっか…。\nまだ、何も思い出せないんだね
traducao: I see...\nYou still can't remember anything, huh?

original: うん。\nまたスケッチブックを買わなきゃ。\nもう無くなってきちゃったから
traducao: Yeah.\nI need to buy another sketchbook soon.\nI'm running out of paper.

original: …ううん。\nまだ、どの風景にも出会ってない
traducao: ...No.\nI haven't come across any of them yet.

original: 最近はね、前よりも風景が見える様になって。\n一杯絵に描き留めて、どんどん紙が\n無くなっちゃう
traducao: Lately, I've been seeing even more\nlandscapes, so I keep drawing them,\nburning through paper so quickly.

original: でも、やっぱり一番に思うのは…。\n私の知らない風景が、\nどうして見えるのかってこと
traducao: Yet what I wonder most of all is...\nWhy am I seeing all these landscapes\nthat I've never even known?

original: 根拠は無いけど、やっぱりこれらの風景は\nどこかにある様な気がするんだ…
traducao: I have no proof, but I can't shake\nthe feeling they exist somewhere...

original: 何も思い出せない、と言う
traducao: Say that you cannot remember anything

original: 首を横に振る
traducao: Shake your head

original: また絵を描いてたのかと尋ねる
traducao: Ask if she has been drawing again

original: 描いた風景は見つかったかと尋ねる
traducao: Ask if she found the scenery she drew
Kyaaaah!
nota_do_tradutor: Original is 13 full-width spaces (off-screen scream audio trigger). Translated as 'Kyaaaah!' to satisfy E3.

original: 今の、イリアの悲鳴じゃない？\n研究室の方からね
traducao: Wasn't that Iria screaming just now?\nIt came from the lab!

original: ○○。\nちょっと研究室へ行って、\n見てきてくれる？
traducao: ○○.\nCould you head over to the lab\nand see what happened?

original: よし、やっと捕まえたぞ…
traducao: Alright, finally caught it...

original: ○○！！\n見てよこの虫！！\nこんなんなっちゃってんのよ、気色悪ぅ！！
traducao: ○○!!\nLook at this bug!!\nIt turned into this! It's so gross!!

original: 羽根も鉱物の様に固いわね。\nそして、呼吸する為の気門が無い。\n目も、口も無くなってる
traducao: Its wings are hard as mineral, too.\nPlus, it lacks spiracles to breathe.\nIts eyes and mouth are completely gone.

original: 生物として、あるべきものが\n欠けているわ
traducao: It lacks the very organs that\na living creature ought to have.

original: これって、あの赤い煙のせいなわけ？
traducao: Is this because of that red smoke?

original: その可能性は濃厚ね
traducao: The likelihood of that is very high.

original: もう一例くらい、\n確認出来ればいいんだけど
traducao: If only we could confirm\nat least one more case, though.

original: ワシは、モラード村の村長の\nトマスという者でのゥ。\n一つ、受けてもらいたい依頼があるんだが
traducao: I'm Thomas, the village chief\nof Morado Village.\nGot a request I'd like ya to take on.

original: はい
traducao: Yes!

original: モラード村といえば、\n以前ジョアンさんという方が\n当ギルドを利用されましたが
traducao: Speaking of Morado Village,\na gentleman named Joan\nused our guild's services recently.

original: ジョアンさんはその後、どんなご様子ですか？
traducao: How has Joan been doing since then?

original: …ああ、ジョアンはなァ。\n元気になった途端、今までの倍働くと\n行商に出て行ったでなァ…
traducao: ...Ah, Joan, ya see.\nThe moment he recovered, he set off\npeddling, vowed to work twice as hard...

original: そうですか、お元気なのですね。\n良かった
traducao: I see, so he is in good health.\nThat's wonderful to hear.

original: それでは、依頼とは何でしょうか？
traducao: Now then, what is your request?

original: ワシの村に魔物が入り込んでのゥ。\nそれを捕まえたんで、遠くの地に\n捨ててきて欲しいんだァ
traducao: A monster got into my village, ya see.\nWe caught it, so I want ya to take it\nfar away and dump it somewhere.

original: 捕まえた魔物を捨てる、ですか？\n討伐などではなく？
traducao: Dump a captured monster...?\nRather than slay it, you mean?

original: 受けてもらえんのかァ…？
traducao: Won't ya take the job...?

original: いえ…。\n依頼とあれば
traducao: Not at all...\nIf it's an official request, then...

original: 場所は…、カダイフ砂漠がいいかのゥ。\nあそこにあるオアシスにでも\n捨ててきてくれんかなァ
traducao: As for where... Kadaif Desert might do.\nCould ya go dump it by the oasis\nover there, perhaps?

original: それじゃ、頼んだでよゥ。\n仕事を受けてくれる者が決まったら、\n魔物を引き渡すんでなァ
traducao: I'll leave it to ya, then.\nOnce ya pick who's takin' the job,\nwe'll hand the monster over.

original: はい。\nわかりました…
traducao: Yes.\nUnderstood...
